candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal S-series)
candidates.why_relevant: Single authoritative publication venue for EU-managed (IPA/EEAS/DG NEAR) contract notices and contract award notices covering Kosovo, including financial-sector TA, banking supervision, and payment-system contracts. Award notices name winning supplier, consortium and contract value.
candidates.access_status: public, free, no login for browsing/search
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED Search API / bulk eForms download (docs.ted.europa.eu) with filters on place-of-performance = Kosovo (XK) and CPV codes 66xxxxxx (financial/banking), 72xxxxxx (IT services), 48xxxxxx (software); fall back to HTML notice pages by notice id.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from search results
queries_used: TED contract award notice Kosovo financial sector payment systems IPA

candidates.source_name: TED Developer Documentation / eForms schema & bulk data
candidates.why_relevant: Defines the machine-readable structure of every TED notice (eForms), the search API, and bulk XML packages — the technical key to automating award-notice harvesting for Kosovo financial-sector contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read once to build the extraction schema; monitor for eForms version changes.
queries_used: TED contract award notice Kosovo financial sector payment systems IPA

candidates.source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (SEDIA) — calls for tenders and calls for proposals
candidates.why_relevant: Central entry point for Commission-managed procurement and grants, including IPA III actions where Kosovo is an eligible beneficiary; carries tender documents, annexes and (for some) results. Complements TED with fuller documentation packages.
candidates.access_status: public browsing; EU Login required for submission and for some documents
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the portal's public search endpoints filtered by programme=IPA III and keyword (Kosovo, financial, payment, banking); heavy JS front-end so prefer the underlying JSON search service over HTML scraping.
queries_used: EU Funding and Tenders Portal IPA Kosovo public finance banking supervision call for proposals

candidates.source_name: DG ENEST — Kosovo: financial assistance under IPA
candidates.why_relevant: Country page listing IPA financing decisions, annual action documents and sector allocations for Kosovo — the upstream signal that tells you which financial-sector/PFM/digital contracts will be tendered 6-18 months later.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the page plus its linked action-document PDFs; extract action titles, budgets and indicative implementation modality (direct/indirect management).
queries_used: TED contract award notice Kosovo financial sector payment systems IPA
EU Funding and Tenders Portal IPA Kosovo public finance banking supervision call for proposals

candidates.source_name: DG ENEST — Funding recipients / Aid transparency (IATI, beneficiaries search)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes contract-level beneficiary data for enlargement funding, including contracts signed under indirect management by partner countries — the way to see who actually got paid on Kosovo IPA financial-sector actions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download IATI activity files for DG ENEST and filter recipient-country = Kosovo; cross-join with TED award notices on contractor name.
queries_used: EU Financial Transparency System beneficiaries search contracts IPA Kosovo; EU Aid Explorer

candidates.source_name: European Commission Financial Transparency System (FTS)
candidates.why_relevant: Searchable database of EU budget beneficiaries under direct and indirect management; useful to identify vendors paid on Kosovo-related enlargement lines even when the TED award notice is thin. Caveat found in EC guidance: IPA is partly managed nationally, so FTS coverage of Kosovo contracts is incomplete.
candidates.access_status: public, free search + annual bulk exports
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual bulk export, filter by beneficiary country / action title containing Kosovo, IPA, financial.
queries_used: EU Financial Transparency System beneficiaries search contracts IPA Kosovo; EU Aid Explorer

candidates.source_name: EEAS — Tenders (central EEAS tender listing)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates delegation-level calls for tender and prior information notices, including those of the EU Office in Kosovo; low-value contracts here never reach TED, so this is the only public trace of them.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginated crawl (URL supports ?s= offset paging) with filter on 'Kosovo' in title/body; store PIN deadlines and contact mailboxes.
queries_used: EEAS EU Office in Kosovo calls for tenders procurement page

candidates.source_name: European Union Office in Kosovo / EUSR — delegation website (tenders & projects)
candidates.why_relevant: The contracting authority for locally-managed EU tenders in Kosovo. Its Finance, Contracts and Audit Section (Seksioni i Financave, Kontratave dhe Auditimit / Odsek za finansije i ugovore, delegation-kosovo-fincon@eeas.europa.eu) issues the calls; the site publishes tender notices in en/sq/sr.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the delegation news/tenders sections in all three language variants (_en, _sq, _sr); node URLs are language-suffixed so fetch each variant.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sq and sr local-language queries + en query, snowballed
queries_used: Zyra e BE-së në Kosovë thirrje për tender sektori financiar
Kancelarija Evropske unije na Kosovu javne nabavke tenderi poziv
EEAS EU Office in Kosovo calls for tenders procurement page
local_language_terms_used: Seksioni i Financave, Kontratave dhe Auditimit

candidates.source_name: EEAS — EU Projects with Kosovo
candidates.why_relevant: Delegation-curated inventory of running EU-funded projects in Kosovo; each entry names the implementing contractor/consortium, budget and sector — a bridge from award notice to who is actually delivering financial-sector and digitalisation work.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl; diff project list to detect newly signed contracts.
queries_used: "EU4" Kosovo programme EU funded projects list digital payments public finance

candidates.source_name: WeBalkans.eu — EU funding opportunities and projects in Kosovo
candidates.why_relevant: EU-run communication platform aggregating IPA III, EU4 programmes, Digital Europe and Horizon participation for the Western Balkans; a fast index of programme names and acronyms to feed back into TED/F&T searches.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl country and programme pages; harvest programme/acronym vocabulary for query expansion.
queries_used: "EU4" Kosovo programme EU funded projects list digital payments public finance

candidates.source_name: EU4Digital Facility (regional programme incl. Kosovo)
candidates.why_relevant: Regional EU4-branded facility covering digital economy/e-payments topics where Kosovo is a listed beneficiary; its phases are tendered as large multi-country service contracts, so award notices reveal the incumbent consortium for digital/payments advisory across the region.
candidates.access_status: public; programme site and tender records dispersed across EC and aggregators
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the phrase 'EU4Digital' in TED and F&T; also monitor the Western Balkans digital agenda documents for successor phases.
queries_used: "EU4" Kosovo programme EU funded projects list digital payments public finance

candidates.source_name: EU Twinning instrument — Kosovo twinning fiches (DG ENEST / member-state NCP sites)
candidates.why_relevant: Twinning is a preferred IPA implementation modality in Kosovo, used for central-bank and public-finance institution building. Fiches (numbered e.g. KS/xx/IPA/...) state the beneficiary institution, budget and mandated results before any procurement — earliest reliable signal of an incoming financial-supervision project.
candidates.access_status: public, but fiches are scattered PDFs also mirrored on member-state twinning National Contact Point sites
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted PDF harvesting on the fiche reference pattern 'KS' + 'IPA' + year across ec.europa.eu and MS NCP domains (e.g. bmeia.gv.at); parse basic-information block for beneficiary and budget.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search + snowball to member-state NCP mirror
queries_used: Twinning fiche Kosovo Central Bank banking supervision IPA project

candidates.source_name: IPA project fiches archive (DG ENEST document download service)
candidates.why_relevant: Historic and current Kosovo IPA project fiches (e.g. public finance) give the full intervention logic, indicative contract split (service/supply/twinning) and budgets — directly predictive of tender structure.
candidates.access_status: public PDFs behind opaque UUID download URLs (no directory listing)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Discover UUIDs via site search / sitemap and via web-search operators; store PDFs and text-extract.
queries_used: Twinning fiche Kosovo Central Bank banking supervision IPA project

candidates.source_name: FWC SEA 2023 — Framework Contract Services for the EU's External Action (successor to FWC SIEA 2018)
candidates.why_relevant: Most short/medium EU technical assistance in Kosovo (including financial sector, PFM and digital payments advisory) is contracted through FWC lots rather than open tenders, so the framework lot holders are the de-facto pre-selected supplier pool. Lot 8 (Sustainable Finance) and the ICT/digital lots are the relevant cells.
candidates.source_subtype: framework contract / consortium disclosure by lot holder
candidates.access_status: public (lot-holder corporate pages); the consolidated official lot-holder list sits on EC/DG INTPA pages
candidates.legal_status: corporate publication about a public contract; cite, do not bulk-republish
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Build a register of FWC SEA 2023 lot leaders and consortium members from lot-holder websites plus the original TED award notices; then treat those firms as watchlist entities for Kosovo assignments.
candidates.discovered_via_method: targeted query on EU framework contracts
queries_used: framework contract SIEA 2023 EU external action lot finance Western Balkans technical assistance

candidates.source_name: Publications Office of the EU — public procurement (EU institutions' own tenders)
candidates.why_relevant: Hosts procurement detail pages for EU-institution and facility tenders, including Western Balkans Investment Framework technical-assistance packages that reach Kosovo; complements TED with full procurement detail records.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl procurement-detail pages; filter for Western Balkans / Kosovo / digital / financial keywords.
queries_used: Western Balkans Investment Framework WBIF Kosovo technical assistance grant procurement notices

candidates.source_name: Western Balkans Investment Framework (WBIF) — grant and TA pipeline
candidates.why_relevant: EU-led blending facility (EC + EIB/EBRD/CEB) financing Kosovo projects including digital-economy infrastructure; its Infrastructure Project Facility TA packages are tendered EU-side and their outputs shape later national payment/digital procurements.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the WBIF project database filtered on Kosovo and the digital sector; cross-reference IPF TA numbers with EIB and op.europa.eu procurement pages.
queries_used: Western Balkans Investment Framework WBIF Kosovo technical assistance grant procurement notices

candidates.source_name: EIB — calls for technical assistance (WBIF/IPF series)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes the TA calls the EIB runs on behalf of WBIF, several of which cover Kosovo and digital-economy scope; award information identifies the consultancy consortia active in the region.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the calls index and per-call pages; filter on 'Western Balkans', 'Kosovo', 'digital'.
queries_used: Western Balkans Investment Framework WBIF Kosovo technical assistance grant procurement notices

candidates.source_name: DevelopmentAid — EU/IPA tender and award aggregator
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that indexes EU external-action tenders (incl. multi-country ones naming Kosovo) with sector tagging such as Macro-Economy & Public Finance and ICT; useful for retrospective discovery of notices that are hard to re-find on TED.
candidates.access_status: partial paywall / registration for full records
candidates.legal_status: proprietary aggregation — use for discovery/lead only, verify against TED before reuse
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume lookup for lead discovery; always resolve to the primary TED or F&T notice.
queries_used: "EU4" Kosovo programme EU funded projects list digital payments public finance
candidates.observed_blocker: Full tender records appear gated behind account/subscription on developmentaid.org (inferred from listing pages; not fetched).

candidates.source_name: javne-nabavke.com / nabavke.com — Serbian-language procurement aggregators covering Kosovo and EEAS notices
candidates.why_relevant: Serbian-language aggregators republish notices for the Kosovo region, including EEAS contracting-authority items (e.g. design services for renovation of the European Union Office in Kosovo). Provides sr-language surface for EU-channel notices that the EEAS site does not always mirror.
candidates.access_status: partly free listing, details likely registration-gated
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of the Kosovo region page for sr-language cross-checks and entity-name variants; treat as secondary.
queries_used: Kancelarija Evropske unije na Kosovu javne nabavke tenderi poziv

candidates.source_name: EU u Srbiji / euzatebe.rs — 'EU javni pozivi' (EU calls listing, sr)
candidates.why_relevant: EU Delegation-run Serbian-language listing of EU calls and tenders; a model for how EU-channel notices are localised in sr, and occasionally carries regional/multi-country calls that include Kosovo. Useful for sr-language terminology harvesting ('javni pozivi', 'EU tenderi').
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl for regional calls; primarily a glossary/terminology source for sr queries.

candidates.source_name: EULEX Kosovo — procurement notices
candidates.why_relevant: EU CSDP mission in Kosovo running its own EU-rules procurement; marginal for payments/banking scope but part of the EU-level contracting surface reaching Kosovo and occasionally covering IT/financial administration services.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /docs/tenders/ document paths and the tenders index page; parse attachments.
queries_used: EEAS EU Office in Kosovo calls for tenders procurement page

candidates.source_name: EUR-Lex — Participation of Kosovo in EU programmes (legal basis summaries)
candidates.why_relevant: Establishes which EU programmes Kosovo may participate in and under what agreements — determines whether a given EU call is even open to Kosovo entities, which is the eligibility filter for the whole cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read plus watch on amending decisions; use CELEX identifiers.
queries_used: "EU4" Kosovo programme EU funded projects list digital payments public finance

candidates.source_name: BQK (Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo) — donor-funded contract award notices (boundary source)
candidates.why_relevant: Discovered while searching EU/IPA channels: BQK publishes contract award notices for donor-funded financial-sector work (e.g. a TIPS-clone connectivity services award under a Financial Sector Development Project). Even though that instance is World Bank-financed, it is the beneficiary-side mirror where EU/IFI-funded payment-system contracts surface with supplier names.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the BQK site's uploads and procurement/notices sections monthly; PDF text extraction on 'Contract Award Notice' documents. Note: this overlaps another coverage cell — flag for de-duplication.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language searching for EU Office in Kosovo financial-sector tender calls ('Zyra e BE-së në Kosovë thirrje për tender sektori financiar') returned no dedicated sq-language tender listing page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results surfaced the delegation's institutional sq pages (kush-jemi-ne_sq, bashkimi-evropian-dhe-kosova_sq) and a job board, not tender notices. EU-channel tender notices for Kosovo appear to be published predominantly in English, with only institutional/communication content localised into sq.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's premise: for EU-level procurement the working language is English, so sq/sr querying is useful mainly for actor names and glossary, not for finding the notices themselves. Collection design should not depend on sq-language tender feeds.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language search for EU Office in Kosovo procurement ('Kancelarija Evropske unije na Kosovu javne nabavke tenderi poziv') found no official sr-language EU tender feed for Kosovo.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only third-party sr aggregators (javne-nabavke.com, nabavke.com) republishing EEAS notices, plus the delegation's sr 'ko smo mi' page naming the Finance and Contracts Section (Odsek za finansije i ugovore, delegation-kosovo-fincon@eeas.europa.eu).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr-language coverage of this cell must be obtained via commercial aggregators or by translating English notices; there is no primary sr channel to monitor.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo central-bank / banking-supervision Twinning fiche was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search surfaced Kosovo twinning fiches in other sectors (personal data protection, public finance, media) and a regional 'Strengthening Central Bank Capacities in the Western Balkans' programme naming CBK/BQK as beneficiary, but no Kosovo-specific banking-supervision twinning fiche document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either such a fiche does not exist (Kosovo central-bank support may run through regional ESCB programmes and IMF/WB rather than twinning) or it is buried in non-indexed PDFs. Needs a dedicated deeper pass before concluding.

negative_findings.description: FTS coverage of IPA Kosovo contracts is structurally incomplete.
negative_findings.result_summary: EC guidance encountered in results states that for IPA one should consult national IPA coordinators rather than the Financial Transparency System, because a share of IPA is not under direct management.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any vendor-level analysis built on FTS alone will systematically under-count Kosovo IPA contracts; must be complemented with TED award notices and DG ENEST/IATI beneficiary data.

negative_findings.description: No source in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all URLs are search-derived.
negative_findings.result_summary: This pass used web search only. Some URLs (notably the wbif.eu root, the EIB TA calls index, the DG ENEST twinning landing page and the EEAS Kosovo delegation root) are constructed from known site structure rather than observed in a result snippet, and are flagged with lower confidence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve these; a 403/404 on any of them should be treated as a hypothesis to re-check, not proof the source is dead.

coverage_gaps.description: TED and the EU Funding & Tenders Portal are JavaScript-heavy single-page applications; naive HTML fetching will not yield notice content.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Implement collection against the TED Search API and eForms bulk packages, and against the F&T Portal's underlying JSON search service, rather than page scraping.

coverage_gaps.description: Award notices name consortium leaders, not the sub-contractors who actually deliver payment-system or card-personalisation components.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair TED award data with lot-holder/consortium disclosures (FWC SEA 2023 lot pages, corporate project pages) and with beneficiary-side publications (BQK, Ministry of Finance) to reconstruct the real delivery chain.

coverage_gaps.description: IPA III indirect-management contracts awarded by Kosovo authorities under EU rules (CFCU-type arrangements) were not mapped in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Determine whether Kosovo has an accredited contracting structure for indirect management and, if so, locate its notice publication venue; otherwise confirm all IPA contracting for Kosovo remains EU-Office-managed.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/bulk historical view of Kosovo-related TED notices was established (pre-eForms TED XML, and third-party archives such as OpenTED/OpenOpps).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate TED historical bulk XML archives and open re-publishers for a multi-year backfile so award trends and incumbent shares can be computed.

coverage_gaps.description: No primary sq- or sr-language EU-channel tender feed exists for Kosovo; local-language coverage of this cell is currently only via glossary terms and third-party aggregators.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use the confirmed sq/sr terminology ('thirrje për tender', 'njoftim për kontratë', 'javne nabavke', 'javni poziv', 'Zyra e BE-së në Kosovë', 'Kancelarija EU na Kosovu') to monitor the delegation's _sq/_sr node variants and local media reporting on EU contracts, and rely on English for the notices themselves.

coverage_gaps.description: BQK's own donor-funded award notices and the World Bank Financial Sector Development Project surfaced inside this EU-focused cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Flag for cross-cell de-duplication and decide ownership: the EU cell should keep only the EU/IPA-financed subset while the beneficiary/regulator cell owns BQK publications wholesale.

brief: EU-level procurement reaching Kosovo is a small, highly structured and almost entirely English-language landscape: TED carries the legally required contract and award notices (with supplier names and values), the EU Funding & Tenders Portal carries the fuller documentation packages, and the EU Office in Kosovo publishes the locally-managed, below-threshold calls on the EEAS site. Upstream intent is visible earlier and more richly in DG ENEST's Kosovo IPA financing decisions, action documents and twinning fiches, while downstream reality is visible in DG ENEST/IATI beneficiary data, the FTS (incomplete for IPA), and beneficiary-side publications such as BQK's own award notices. A large share of EU technical assistance never appears as an open tender at all because it is called off under the FWC SEA 2023 framework lots, so tracking the lot-holding consortia is as important as tracking notices. Albanian- and Serbian-language searching confirmed there is no primary local-language tender feed for this channel — local terms are useful for actor names and delegation page variants, not for finding the notices.
